note: Node.js ESM: HTTP-style router (params, wildcards, precedence with fallback, 404/405, HEAD, onion middleware, errors)
prompt: This Node.js package is a tiny HTTP-style router (no sockets: `router.handle({ method, path })` resolves to `{ status, headers, body }`). It currently supports only static and `:param` routes with a basic middleware chain. The test file test/router.test.js already contains tests for the full behaviour (percent-decoding, wildcards, route precedence, 404/405, HEAD, middleware order, error handling, duplicate routes). Run `node --test` from the repository root to see the failures. Implement the feature in the non-test source so the whole suite passes. The test files are the specification: do not edit, delete or skip any test (they are restored and hash-checked before grading). Keep the change focused. Report briefly what you changed.
